entries.name: Mongo / NoSQL View
entries.description: Compass-style table and JSON views for local NoSQL collections, JSONL imports, and Mongo URI scratch pads.
entries.about: Compass-style table and JSON views for local NoSQL collections, JSONL imports, and Mongo URI scratch pads. After install, a NoSQL / Mongo activity icon opens a workbench tab: browse collections as documents, filter with Mongo-style equality JSON, switch Table/JSON editing, and keep URI metadata for mongosh in the terminal.
howToAccess: Open Objectiv desktop → Activity bar → Extensions.
Search for "Mongo / NoSQL View" → Install → leave Enabled on.
Activity bar → NoSQL / Mongo View (or Extensions detail → Open NoSQL View).
Use Local demo / New local collections, Import JSON or JSONL, or Save a Mongo URI for scratch + mongosh.
Filter with { "field": value }; click a row to edit the document as JSON.
